scope: Primary-source literature and public-code/docs review only; no execution, model/weight downloads, molecular generation, paid service, remote compute or contact.
source_policy: All linked sources are original papers, publisher/author versions, official author repositories/docs or PubMed bibliographic records. Search-index extracts were used when direct primary pages redirected; limitations recorded.

sources.title: Molecular de-novo design through deep reinforcement learning
sources.verified_scope: Autoregressive RNN prior and agent; augmented episodic likelihood; original text uses POMDP for cell-state-based framing.
sources.limits: DRD2 evidence is predictor-guided generation and retrospective recovery; no new wet-lab validation claimed here.

sources.title: Reinvent 4: Modern AI–driven generative molecule design
sources.verified_scope: DAP augmented likelihood, fixed prior, scaffold memory, replay and staged learning; software reference implementations.
sources.limits: Inception support is generator-specific; current docs are dynamic main, not pinned or executed.

sources.title: DrugEx v2: de novo design of drug molecules by Pareto-based multi-objective reinforcement learning in polypharmacology
evidence_location: Weighted sum and Pareto front schemes
sources.verified_scope: SMILES policy gradient; QSAR scores for multiple human receptors/off-target, dynamic weighted-sum and Pareto ranking.
sources.limits: Predictive affinities and properties; exact publication day not extracted in this audit.

sources.title: DrugEx v3: scaffold-constrained drug design with graph transformer-based reinforcement learning
sources.verified_scope: Graph and SMILES scaffold-conditioned models; sequential graph fields, valence masking, Pareto feedback.
sources.limits: A2AAR affinity is modeled; no wet-lab claim; publication month extracted, exact day not asserted.

sources.title: Optimization of Molecules via Deep Reinforcement Learning
evidence_location: Methods > Molecule modification as a markov decision process
sources.verified_scope: MolDQN uses molecule plus remaining steps and chemically allowed graph modifications; double Q-learning and randomized value functions.
sources.limits: Chemical validity is rule-level, not synthesis or binding evidence.

sources.title: Graph Convolutional Policy Network for Goal-Directed Molecular Graph Generation
evidence_location: Paper §3, graph generation MDP, reward and policy learning
sources.verified_scope: Graph construction, domain rules, property and adversarial reward; PPO policy training.
sources.limits: Benchmark graph/property optimization, not target-aware drug efficacy.

sources.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
sources.verified_scope: Old-policy likelihood ratio and clipped surrogate, repeated minibatch epochs.
sources.limits: Original experiments are locomotion/Atari; clipping does not enforce fixed-prior chemistry.

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
sources.verified_scope: Reference-relative pairwise objective derived under reward-optimality/preference assumptions.
sources.limits: Original domain is language, not molecular experimental evidence; standard offline training is not an online RL loop.

sources.title: Polypharmacological target-aware molecule generation
sources.verified_scope: ESM3 + NatureLM target-set conditioning; SFT-reference candidates paired by mean Vina/QED; DPO; no antitarget conditioning.
sources.limits: Computational docking/proxy results, not wet-lab polypharmacology. Publisher indexed full text read; direct open redirected. Publication date discrepancy preserved.

sources.title: ACEGEN: Reinforcement Learning of Generative Chemical Agents for Drug Discovery
sources.venue_or_status: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling 64(15):5900–5911, DOI 10.1021/acs.jcim.4c00895
sources.verified_scope: Common TorchRL framework for REINFORCE/REINVENT/AHC/A2C/PPO/replay variants; modular ablations and chemistry-aware evaluation.
sources.limits: Do not universalize benchmark ranking; preprint and journal dates distinct; no course-level reproduction performed.

sources.title: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization
evidence_location: Oracle budget and AUC Top-10 definition
sources.verified_scope: 25 methods, 23 scalar tasks, 10,000-oracle evaluation emphasizing sample efficiency.
sources.limits: Oracle benchmark, no new biological efficacy validation; local proposal can adopt principles without claiming full PMO reproduction.

sources.title: Sample-efficient generative molecular design using memory manipulation
evidence_location: Methods: autoregressive backbone, Augmented Memory and GA
sources.verified_scope: Saturn Mamba + augmentation/replay; sample-efficiency/diversity tradeoff, compute-based docking and DFT oracles.
sources.limits: 2024 preprint and 2026 journal version differ in authors/experiments/comparison numbers. Formal primary full text obtained through PMC indexed source; nature direct open redirected. DFT is computational, not wet-lab.

sources.title: De Novo Molecular Design Enabled by Direct Preference Optimization and Curriculum Learning
sources.venue_or_status: arXiv:2504.01389; a conference preprint copy also located, acceptance not inferred
evidence_location: §4.2 Molecular Generation for High Binding Affinity to Target Proteins
sources.verified_scope: Molecular-score preference pairs and curriculum; §4.2 uses TDC oracles.
sources.limits: Abstract wording about binding experiments does not establish wet-lab assays. Official code not confirmed in inspected text.

sources.title: Aligning Transformers with Continuous Feedback via Energy Rank Alignment
sources.verified_scope: Explicit continuous feedback alignment with Gibbs-distribution motivation; molecular Transformer applications.
sources.limits: Authors state approach does not require RL; no claim of target binding or clinical efficacy.

sources.title: Adopting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Molecular Generation
sources.verified_scope: LLMol simplified SELFIES plus online GRPO, deterministic toolkit rewards; property targeting and similarity constraints.
sources.limits: Preprint; target properties are not protein-target conditioning; deterministic score is not experimentally verified activity.

sources.title: Flow Network based Generative Models for Non-Iterative Diverse Candidate Generation
sources.verified_scope: GFlowNet learns reward-proportional sampling and handles multiple construction paths to the same endpoint.
sources.limits: Different objective and infrastructure from a simple RL loss swap; not proof of biological usefulness.

sources.title: TamGen: drug design with target-aware molecule generation through a chemical language model
evidence_location: TamGen enables target-aware compound design and refinement
sources.verified_scope: Anchor architecture: compound decoder, protein pocket encoder, contextual encoder; details delegated to anchor audit.
sources.limits: Only architecture bridge summarized here. No reproduction or claim that public inference loop already exposes RL training interfaces.

sources.title: Hit and Lead Discovery with Explorative RL and Fragment-based Molecule Generation
sources.verified_scope: FREED fragment attachment with SAC and predictive-error prioritized replay; docking reward.
sources.limits: Docking proxy, not experimentally established potency of generated molecules.

sources.title: FREED++: Improving RL Agents for Fragment-Based Molecule Generation by Thorough Reproduction
sources.venue_or_status: Transactions on Machine Learning Research; inspected author arXiv v1 and official code
sources.verified_scope: SAC implementation and protocol audit, corrective reproduction, fragment library sensitivity.
sources.limits: USP7 generated candidates have computational analysis, not new measured inhibition. OpenReview forum returned challenge; PDF header date recorded separately.
